clues.it: Bruno era nella 1ª colonna, nella 1ª riga e a nord di Irene.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 1st column, in the 1st row and north of Irene.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 12ª colonna e in una stanza diversa da Nino.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 12th column and in a different room from Nino.

clues.it: Rosa era a ovest di Anna e in Plancia.
clues.en: Rosa was west of Anna and on the Bridge.

clues.it: Anna era a nord di Irene e in Cabina.
clues.en: Anna was north of Irene and in the Cabin.

clues.it: Marta era nella 5ª colonna, accanto a una cassa e in una stanza diversa da Ugo.
clues.en: Marta was in the 5th column, beside a crate and in a different room from Ugo.

clues.it: Irene era nella 9ª colonna, nella 6ª riga e nella stessa stanza di Marta.
clues.en: Irene was in the 9th column, in the 6th row and in the same room as Marta.

clues.it: Nino era nella 7ª riga, accanto a una cassa e a ovest di Tea.
clues.en: Nino was in the 7th row, beside a crate and west of Tea.

clues.it: Vito era nella 8ª riga e accanto a una pozza o a una rete.
clues.en: Vito was in the 8th row and beside a puddle or a net.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Tea era nella 10ª riga e accanto a un'ancora o a una rete.
clues.en: Tea was in the 10th row and beside an anchor or a net.

clues.it: Giada era nella 10ª colonna e accanto a una corda.
clues.en: Giada was in the 10th column and beside a rope coil.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 8ª colonna ed esattamente una riga a nord di Dario.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 8th column and exactly one row north of Dario.

clues.it: Dario era nella 4ª colonna, accanto a una sedia e sul Molo.
clues.en: Dario was in the 4th column, beside a chair and on the Dock.

clues.it: Luca era accanto a una sedia e a ovest di Anna.
clues.en: Luca was beside a chair and west of Anna.

general_clues.en: 7 in the west half of the grid.
7 in the north half of the grid.

steps.en: Tea can only be in the 13th column: ruling it out leaves Anna a single square: row 4th, column 14th.

steps.en: The general clue “1 beside a barrel” cannot add up without Ugo: they must be at row 2nd, column 12th.
